## Steps
1. Before each file edit ask: is this file in the plan, or needed for a criterion? If not, do not edit it.
2. Put extra ideas in your summary under Next. Do not build them.
3. Do not touch build, container, CI or lock files unless the task names them.
4. Never edit or delete an existing test to make it pass.
5. Keep the change small. If it grows past about 300 changed lines, stop and say so.
6. At the end list each criterion with the command that shows it works.
7. End with the five-line summary from the final-summary skill.
## Checklist
- [ ] Every changed file is in the plan or needed for a criterion.
- [ ] No unrelated cleanup, setting or feature was added.
- [ ] Every criterion maps to a passing test or a command output you saw.
## Definition of done
All criteria are met by tests or outputs you saw in this run, and nothing outside the plan changed.
## Verify
Compare the files you changed with the plan. Run the test command last.
## Common mistakes
- "While I am here" refactors of other files.
- Adding a setting or option nobody asked for.
- Changing a test because it is in the way.
- Saying done while one criterion has no proof.
## Example
Task: fix the discount at exactly 100. Changed: `shop.py` (one line), new `tests/test_edge.py`. Not done: renaming `total` (listed under Next).
